# Apple Podcasts

> > Apple Podcasts is a comprehensive podcast directory featuring shows on business, technology, politics, and entertainment, with strong representation of Russian political commentary, ecommerce education, and professional development content.

The platform hosts diverse content ranging from Russian news analysis (Живой Гвоздь) and international affairs (The Economist) to specialized topics like Amazon FBA strategies, software engineering, and IELTS preparation. Content includes both English and Russian language podcasts serving global audiences.

## Key Topics

- Apple Podcasts
- Russian Political Commentary (Живой Гвоздь)
- Business & Ecommerce Strategies
- Software Engineering & Technology
- Netflix & Entertainment Recommendations
- TikTok Trends & Viral Memes
- Know Your Meme Explanations
- Current Events & News Analysis
- Professional Development & Leadership
- Online Marketing & Content Creation
- TV Listings & Streaming Guides
- Political Analysis (Trump, Putin, Iran)
- Workplace Productivity
- IELTS Exam Preparation
- Real Estate Innovation

## Featured Podcasts

- [Живой Гвоздь — Russian Political Commentary](https://podcasts.apple.com/ru/podcast/мадуро-никто-не-похищал-отравление-навального-чем-плох/id1616175210): Russian news podcast featuring political commentary with expert opinions
- [Software Engineering Radio](https://podcasts.apple.com/am/podcast/software-engineering-radio-the-podcast-for/id120906714): Weekly software engineering tutorials & expert interviews from IEEE
- [The Economist Asks](https://podcasts.apple.com/ae/podcast/the-economist-asks/id1108555682): Weekly newsmaker interviews with Anne McElvoy from The Economist
- [Fixable](https://podcasts.apple.com/by/podcast/fixable/id1677016372): Harvard leadership coaches solve workplace problems in weekly podcast
- [NosillaCast Apple Podcast](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/nc-881-folge-for-tutorial-guides-qd-laser-assistive/id81677867): Weekly tech podcast with Apple bias covering tutorials, reviews & news
- [The Amy Porterfield Show](https://podcasts.apple.com/au/podcast/624-8-ways-to-address-money-objections-from-your-audience/id594703545): Online business growth & marketing strategies from Amy Porterfield

## Russian Political Analysis

- [Пастуховские Четверги (Vladimir Pastukhov & Alexey Venediktov)](https://podcasts.apple.com/ru/podcast/владимир-пастухов-и-алексей-венедиктов-пастуховские/id1616175210): Weekly Russian political analysis with Vladimir Pastukhov & Alexey Venediktov
- [Sergey Parkhomenko Q&A](https://podcasts.apple.com/ru/podcast/сергей-пархоменко-2026-20-02-26/id1616175210): Q&A with journalist Sergey Parkhomenko on Russian current events
- [Andrey Illarionov on Security Policy](https://podcasts.apple.com/ru/podcast/андрей-илларионов-2026-06-02-26/id1616175210): Security policy expert Andrey Illarionov discusses Russia & world events
- [Пастуховские Четверги (Vladimir Pastukhov & Liza Anikina)](https://podcasts.apple.com/ru/podcast/владимир-пастухов-и-лиза-аникина-пастуховские-четверги/id1616175210): Vladimir Pastukhov & Liza Anikina discuss Russian & global news weekly

## Business & Ecommerce

- [Daily Ecommerce with Ali Akbar Gulshan](https://podcasts.apple.com/ae/podcast/daily-ecommerce-ali-akbar-gulshan/id1829971875): Daily ecommerce tactics & Shopify strategies with Ali Akbar Gulshan
- [Two Amazon Sellers and a Microphone](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/two-amazon-sellers-and-a-microphone/id1533769170): Amazon FBA & selling strategies from Sellozo experts since 2013
- [Thought Leaders – Real Estate Re-imagined](https://podcasts.apple.com/au/podcast/cracking-the-code-mathew-tiller-on-breaking-down/id1280333231): Real estate innovation & leadership insights with Elite Agent's Samantha McLean
- [ProBlogger Podcast](https://podcasts.apple.com/au/podcast/276-how-to-start-a-successful-podcast/id1012723880): Blogging & content creation tips from Darren Rowse's ProBlogger
